- Initial release: accesso-tickets skill for reading mobile ticket links from accessoticketing.com (media-engine URLs).
- Extracts order details, per-ticket info (product, participant, date/time), barcodes, and Google Wallet passes using curl — no login or browser required.
- Parses credentialed ticket links directly; emphasizes security of URLs.
- Outputs JSON with detailed order and ticket fields, including handling extra merchant-specific fields generically.
- Includes options to save barcodes as PNGs and to show terms and conditions.
- Handles known parsing challenges: duplicated elements, non-standard HTTP errors, and positional ticket ID mapping.
